facts.text: Pizza and soft drink for the whole house tonight. Oozma Kappa studies for the Scare Games on a full stomach.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Mike's words, but he never says it. I could not open a quote page for this pass (the search tool was out of budget), so there is no quote source.
facts.fix: Pizza and soft drink for the whole house tonight. Eat up, Oozma Kappa, the Scare Games start soon.
